messages.text: Can we discuss whether we should build a native Android app before the partner summit? A few prospects have asked about it.
Android is possible, but it would pull people off onboarding and analytics. I don't think we have a clean estimate yet.
Sales would love it, but I don't know if it actually unblocks deals. Most of the asks are more like nice-to-have comments.
Let's not decide today. Priya, can you size Android, mobile web improvements, and doing nothing for the next roadmap review?
Agreed. Do not commit yet. We'll revisit once we have usage data and a rough cost estimate.
